- `pricing/salestax.go` (new): `SalesTax`, with the same body and doc comment.
- `pricing/tax.go`: the function is removed. `Region` stays here.
- `pricing/quote.go`: `Price` calls `SalesTax`.
- `pricing/tax_test.go`: calls and failure messages use `SalesTax`. Test names are unchanged.
- `trace/requirements.yaml`: the `code:` anchors for R-TAX-RATE and R-TAX-EXEMPT now point to `pricing/salestax.go#SalesTax`. Item text is untouched.
- `trace.lock`: updated by `ostf_stamp`. I did not edit it by hand.

All are now valid.
- Neither R-TAX-RATE nor R-TAX-EXEMPT is marked risk-relevant, and neither item text was made false by the change.

I have not opened a pull request, since you didn't ask for one. If you want one, the description should name the items and tests above.
